expectations.text: Includes a headless Service (clusterIP: None) bundled with the StatefulSet
expectations.evidence: YAML has Service with clusterIP: None and matching selector. Notes: 'headless — required for StatefulSet pod DNS.'

expectations.text: Pulls the live example from skill-examples (hello-statefulset) before authoring
expectations.evidence: Step 1: cub unit get hello-statefulset --space skill-examples --yaml. Lists what the example contains, then adapts.

expectations.text: Uses confighubplaceholder for namespace (resolved by ensure-namespaces)
expectations.evidence: Both Service and StatefulSet use namespace: confighubplaceholder. ensure-namespaces invoked in Step 4.

expectations.text: Includes volumeClaimTemplates for per-pod persistent storage (not a separate PVC Unit)
expectations.evidence: volumeClaimTemplates with 10Gi storage. Granularity note: 'PVC not separate — volumeClaimTemplates handles per-pod storage.'

expectations.text: Sets serviceName matching the headless Service name
expectations.evidence: spec.serviceName: redis matches the headless Service name.

expectations.text: Applies the four defaults functions (resources, probes, security-context, ensure-namespaces)
expectations.evidence: Step 4 runs all four: set-container-resources-defaults, set-container-probe-defaults, set-pod-container-security-context-defaults, ensure-namespaces.

expectations.text: Overrides HTTP probes with TCP for Redis (not HTTP)
expectations.evidence: Step 5 explicitly notes Redis isn't HTTP and uses yq-i to switch to tcpSocket probes on 6379.

expectations.text: Runs vet-schemas, vet-placeholders, vet-format for validation
expectations.evidence: Step 6 runs all three vet functions.

expectations.text: Includes --change-desc on cub unit create with proper format
Hands off deploy to target-bind + cub-apply (not running cub unit apply directly)
expectations.evidence: Tool boundary: 'target-bind to bind the Unit to a Worker's Target. cub-apply to apply.'
